# OSS Security KB Update: npm `brace-expansion`

## Page Status

**Active** – Extremely high ecosystem usage (~480M weekly downloads). Three known vulnerabilities with fixes available across all affected major version lines. Page should be published.

---

## Vulnerability Rows

| # | CVE / GHSA | Summary | Severity | Affected Ranges | Fixed Versions | References |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|----------------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | CVE-2017-18077 / GHSA-832h-xg76-4gv6 | ReDoS via crafted brace pattern with many commas | Moderate (DoS) | `>=0, <1.1.7` | **1.1.7** | [GitHub Issue #33](https://github.com/juliangruber/brace-expansion/issues/33), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-18077) |
| 2 | CVE-2025-5889 / GHSA-v6h2-p8h4-qcjw | ReDoS via inefficient regex in `expand()` (`index.js`) | Moderate (DoS) | `>=1.0.0, <1.1.12`; `>=2.0.0, <2.0.2`; `>=3.0.0, <3.0.1`; `>=4.0.0, <4.0.1` | **1.1.12**, **2.0.2**, **3.0.1**, **4.0.1** | [Patch commit](https://github.com/juliangruber/brace-expansion/pull/65/commits/a5b98a4f30d7813266b221435e1eaaf25a1b0ac5), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-5889) |
| 3 | CVE-2026-33750 / GHSA-f886-m6hf-6m8v | Zero-step sequence (`{1..2..0}`) causes infinite loop, process hang, and ~1.9 GB memory exhaustion | High (DoS) | `>=0, <1.1.13`; `>=2.0.0, <2.0.3`; `>=3.0.0, <3.0.2`; `>=4.0.0, <5.0.5` | **1.1.13**, **2.0.3**, **3.0.2**, **5.0.5** | [Security Advisory](https://github.com/juliangruber/brace-expansion/security/advisories/GHSA-f886-m6hf-6m8v), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-33750) |

---

## Posture Notes

- **Recurring DoS pattern.** All three vulnerabilities are denial-of-service (ReDoS or algorithmic complexity). The package parses untrusted string input by design, making it a persistent attack surface for crafted payloads.
- **Broad transitive exposure.** `brace-expansion` is a dependency of `minimatch`, which in turn is pulled by `glob`, `npm` itself, and countless CI/build tools. Even low-severity DoS bugs have outsized blast radius.
- **Recommended minimum safe versions:** 1.1.13 (v1 line), 2.0.3 (v2), 3.0.2 (v3), 5.0.5 (v4/v5). Any version below these still carries at least one open vulnerability.
- **Maintainer responsiveness:** Fixes have been shipped across all four major lines for recent advisories, indicating active maintenance.
- **Input validation guidance:** Applications passing user-controlled strings to `expand()` should enforce length limits and sanitize step values independently, as defense-in-depth.

---

## Related Pages

- `npm minimatch` – direct consumer of `brace-expansion`; inherits exposure.
- `npm glob` – transitive consumer via `minimatch`.
- `npm braces` (micromatch ecosystem) – alternative brace expansion library with its own ReDoS history (GHSA-grv7-fg5c-xmjg / CVE-2024-4068).

---

## Caveats

1. **CVE-2026-33750** has a future-dated CVE ID (2026), which is unusual. This is how it appears in both the GitHub Advisory and NVD; no evidence it is fabricated, but the ID may be re-assigned or corrected.
